name: MailerSend
line: Transactional email API and SMTP with a bulk email endpoint.

free.text: Free for 500 emails per 30 days; card required

cells.newsletters: Yes, bulk sends on Hobby+; disclose use and include opt-out
cells.api: Yes, REST API, SMTP relay and official SDKs

subs.math: The Hobby 5,000-email pack covers 4,000 emails to 1,000 readers, after sender approval. Before tax.
Hobby $7 + (15,000 extra emails at $1.50 per 1,000) = $29.50. The $35 Starter 50K plan is the option with no extra charges.
The Starter 50,000-email package covers 40,000 emails to 10,000 subscribers.
The published 250,000-email package covers 200,000 emails to 50,000 subscribers. The exact price for a 200,000-email package is not published.

appmail.math: The Hobby 5,000-email pack covers 3,000 app emails, after sender approval. Before tax.
If extra emails are enabled: Hobby $7 + (5,000 extra emails at $1.50 per 1,000) = $14.50. The Starter 50K plan is $35.
The Starter 50,000-email package covers 50,000 app emails a month.
The Starter 100,000-email package covers 100,000 app emails a month.
